title: 五大主题安全竞赛（国内版）

points.K1: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
points.K6: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
points.S1: 大型仪器搬运找专业队伍
points.S2: 手推车搬运的人机工效

shots.scene: 欣欣站在竞赛台前，背后五块空白展板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a quiz stage with five blank boards behind it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到五大主题安全竞赛！

shots.scene: 五个图标：梯子、火焰、起重机、井口、铁锹
shots.prompt_en: A row of five icons: a ladder, a flame, a crane, a manhole and a shovel. No people.
shots.narration: 高处、消防、起重、有限空间、开挖。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研站在实验楼大厅的竞赛海报前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student stand in front of a blank competition poster in a laboratory building lobby.
shots.narration: 学院要办安全竞赛，阿杰报了名。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头：起重、开挖跟实验室有关吗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking at crane and shovel icons on the poster.
shots.narration: 他问：起重开挖，跟实验室有关吗？

shots.scene: 小研指向窗外：搬仪器的吊车、楼下挖管沟
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points out the window at a small crane lifting a crate and a trench being dug below.
shots.narration: 小研说：搬仪器、修管道，校园里都有。

shots.section_title: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
shots.scene: 五个主题各有一沓题卡，共一百张
shots.prompt_en: Five stacks of blank question cards, one under each topic icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每个主题二十题，一共一百题。
overlay: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题

shots.section_title: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
shots.scene: 题卡背面是答案
shots.prompt_en: A question card flips over to show a green check on the back. No people.
shots.narration: 四选一，附答案，查漏补缺。

shots.scene: 老李站在矮梯上更换灯管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on a short step ladder replacing a ceiling light tube.
shots.narration: 高处作业：什么算高处？

shots.scene: 高度尺图标打叉，坠落图标圈出
shots.prompt_en: A measuring ruler icon is crossed out; an icon of a person falling from an edge is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 只要可能坠落受伤，就算。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家标准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standards handbook.
shots.narration: 高处作业分级，以国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 四个图标：坠落、坏梯子、无护栏边缘、雷雨
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a falling person, a broken ladder, an edge without a railing and a storm cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业常见四种危害。

shots.scene: 老李检查梯子、看看天气
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the ladder feet and glances out the window at the weather.
shots.narration: 梯子先检查，临边要防护，天坏不登高。

shots.scene: 三角形三条边：温度计、木块、氧气符号
shots.prompt_en: A triangle whose three sides show a thermometer, a wooden block and an oxygen symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第一题：火三角是哪三样？

shots.scene: 拿掉一条边，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: One side of the triangle is removed and the flame in the middle goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 热、燃料、氧气，少一样火就灭。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员手持灭火器演示
shots.prompt_en: The security officer holds a portable fire extinguisher, ready to demonstrate.
shots.narration: 消防第二题：灭火器怎么用？

shots.scene: 四步图标：提、拔销、握管、压把
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: lifting an extinguisher, pulling a pin, aiming a hose, pressing a handle. No people.
shots.narration: 提起、拔销、握管对准火根、压把。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向出口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 火大控制不住，立刻撤离打119。

shots.section_title: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
shots.scene: 起重机吊着箱子，旁边风向标在转
shots.prompt_en: A small mobile crane lifts a crate while a wind vane spins beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 起重第一题：多大风还能吊？
overlay: 起重机能吊的风速看机型

shots.section_title: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
shots.scene: 具体数字卡片打叉，说明书图标圈出
shots.prompt_en: Number cards are crossed out with red X marks; a blank manual icon is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 看机型和额定能力，按说明书来。

shots.section_title: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
shots.scene: 风大，吊装暂停
shots.prompt_en: Strong wind lines blow across the site; the crane lowers its load and stops. No people.
shots.narration: 风大超限，就停止吊装。

shots.scene: 起重机伸出四条支腿，垫着垫板
shots.prompt_en: A mobile crane extends four outriggers resting on pads on firm ground. No people.
shots.narration: 起重第二题：支腿有什么用？

shots.scene: 支腿没伸开、车身倾斜的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tilting crane with retracted outriggers is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 支腿让起重机稳住，不是加高增力。

shots.scene: 地下水池的检修口
shots.prompt_en: An open maintenance hatch leading to an underground water tank. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间第一题：什么是有限空间？

shots.scene: 检修口的小门和一个人形，旁边是禁止长期停留图标
shots.prompt_en: A small hatch opening beside a person outline and a clock icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 人能进去干活，但出入口受限。

shots.scene: 风扇图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fan icon crossed out next to the hatch, showing stale air. No people.
shots.narration: 不供长期停留，通风往往不好。

shots.scene: 三个图标：氧气减少、毒气骷髅、塌落物
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an oxygen symbol with a downward arrow, a skull and crossbones and falling debris. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间的主要风险是什么？

shots.scene: 检修口立着警示牌，阿杰停步
shots.prompt_en: A confined space danger sign stands at the hatch; the young male student stops before it.
shots.narration: 缺氧、有毒、物理伤害，未经审批不进。

shots.scene: 校园里挖开的管沟
shots.prompt_en: A trench dug on a campus path with piles of soil beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖第一题：开挖安全为了什么？

shots.scene: 盾牌护着工人图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield protecting a worker icon beside the trench. No people.
shots.narration: 防止事故，保护工人。

shots.scene: 土体滑塌、地下管线两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a trench wall collapsing and an underground pipe with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的危害：土体塌方、碰到管线。

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽、穿反光背心和安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a hard hat, a high visibility vest and safety boots beside the trench.
shots.narration: 开挖的防范：穿戴好防护用品。

shots.scene: 王老师巡查沟槽
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator inspects the trench edge with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 有能力的人定期检查沟槽。

shots.scene: 土壤样本和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A soil sample in a tray with a magnifier above it. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖之前，先弄清土质和管线。

shots.section_title: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
shots.scene: 阿杰在竞赛台上按抢答器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses a buzzer at the quiz stage, smiling.
shots.narration: 五个主题，阿杰都答上来了。

shots.section_title: 大型仪器搬运找专业队伍
shots.scene: 实验室门口一台大型仪器装在木箱里
shots.prompt_en: A large instrument in a wooden crate sits at a laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 新仪器又大又重，怎么搬进实验室？
overlay: 大型仪器搬运找专业队伍

shots.section_title: 大型仪器搬运找专业队伍
shots.scene: 几个学生想硬抬，图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of several students trying to lift a heavy crate by hand is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生别硬抬硬扛。

shots.section_title: 大型仪器搬运找专业队伍
shots.scene: 老李指挥专业搬运人员用液压车运箱子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer directs a hydraulic pallet jack carrying the crate through the corridor.
shots.narration: 找专业队伍，用搬运设备，专人指挥。

shots.section_title: 大型仪器搬运找专业队伍
shots.scene: 地面承重和门宽两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a floor with a weight symbol and a door width arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 先确认楼板承重、门宽和路线。

shots.section_title: 手推车搬运的人机工效
shots.scene: 阿杰拉着装满试剂箱的推车，身体后仰
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls an overloaded cart of boxes behind him, leaning back awkwardly.
shots.narration: 搬试剂箱，阿杰用推车倒着拉。
overlay: 手推车搬运的人机工效

shots.section_title: 手推车搬运的人机工效
shots.scene: 阿杰改为在车后推，箱子码得低于视线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student now pushes the cart from behind, boxes stacked below eye level.
shots.narration: 推车用推不用拉，货别挡住视线。

shots.section_title: 手推车搬运的人机工效
shots.scene: 推车把手高度在腰部
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the young male student gripping a cart handle at waist height, arms relaxed.
shots.narration: 把手齐腰，手臂放松，走慢一点。

shots.section_title: 手推车搬运的人机工效
shots.scene: 小研在门槛和坡道处帮扶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steadies the cart at a door threshold ramp.
shots.narration: 过门槛、坡道，有人帮扶。

shots.scene: 起重机驾驶室旁，司机胸前别着证件
shots.prompt_en: A crane operator cab with a blank license badge displayed inside. No people.
shots.narration: 起重机械属于特种设备。

shots.scene: 王老师查看证件和检验标签
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank operator license and a blank inspection tag on the crane.
shots.narration: 司机和指挥要持证，设备要检验合格。

shots.scene: 吊装区拉起警戒线，人员远离
shots.prompt_en: A barrier line around the lifting area; small person icons stay outside it. No people.
shots.narration: 吊装区域拉警戒，吊物下不站人。

shots.scene: 五个图标排成一行，每个下面一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Five topic icons in a row, each with a green check below it. No people.
shots.narration: 五个主题，一个道理：先识险再动手。

shots.scene: 阿杰推着推车经过整洁的走廊
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a neatly loaded cart down a clean laboratory corridor.
shots.narration: 搬运吊装，交给专业，用对方法。

shots.scene: 小研给阿杰颁发小奖状
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank certificate with a ribbon.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到了竞赛奖状。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye on the quiz stage.
shots.narration: 安全知识常练习，我们下次见！
